title: GET /api/board
description: Every open todo item (one per note section) as a card with its server-computed status and actions. The page groups/filters by repo; it never computes a status.

slots.description: Runs driving right now. There is no cap: every Start runs at once.

auto_close.description: settings.json auto_close: trusted done_checks are polled and a red-to-green one starts a closing run.

columns.description: Always the five columns in this order: backlog, running, needs_you, ready, done.

repos.description: Distinct repos of the cards, sorted; notes with no repo are not listed here (they are the Yours lane).

error.description: Board-level banner (e.g. the todo MCP is unreachable): cards shown are the last known ones and stale. Omitted or null when healthy.

alert.description: A red banner for as long as `until` is in the future: overage = the overage guard killed a plan-route turn that was spending extra usage (money); relay = the phone relay failed closed and text names why (DOCS-native-app-relay.md guard 8). Omitted when none.

api_key.description: Status of the Claude Console API key, worded by the server (omitted until the first check ran). The page shows a banner with `text` when level is warn (amber) or error (red) and nothing when ok.
